source.source_locator: 危険物の規制に関する規則 第40条の2

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 容器積み重ね高さは原則3m、第四類の第三石油類等のみの一定の場合4m、機械荷役構造容器のみの場合6m。
evidence.tested_misconception: 危険物容器は種類・構造を問わず一律6mまで積める。
evidence.reasoning_path: container set -> identify material/container structure -> select 3m/4m/6m limit

collision.note: B3 Tier B multi-boundary calculation/decision; distinct from all canonical 29.

independent_review.rationale: 3m/4m/6m stacking-height boundary is a high-value quantitative decision problem.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the 600Q quality-not-quota contract. The 22 accepted candidates test concrete storage and handling duties, quantitative boundaries, Class-4-specific controls, or explicit sale/record obligations without material collision with the 29 canonical Otsu4 questions. C016 and C017 are too abstract to add sufficient practice value and must not proceed merely to preserve the planned count.
